thread:
Ivy: Pulled a compact pack of signals from 8 onboarding calls today. Short version: one renewal blocker (SSO mapping) + recurring asks for per-route billing CSV, a printable Admin Quickstart checklist, embedding reingest controls, and clearer quota messages for trials. Dropping minimal rows and next-step asks for triage.
Marcus: can you put the renewal-risk first?
Ivy: sure. top rows: 
- P0 | renewal=yes | client: summitcare | issue: SSO attribute mapping mismatch (IdP sends 'mailNick' vs 'email') | note: renewal in 11 days
- P1 | renewal=no | client: trialworks | issue: per-route billing CSV & UI drilldown | note: requested daily export + API
- P1 | renewal=no | client: blueleaf | issue: Admin Quickstart printable checklist | note: wants PDF + JSON schema for auto-fill
- P2 | renewal=no | client: sunridge | issue: embedding reingest | note: wants manual reingest button + webhook on completion
- P2 | renewal=no | client: lattice-ai | issue: quota error UX | note: error message unclear during burst (trial)
Hannah: I'll take the per-route billing spike with @Owen. Proposed fields: route_id, route_label, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_id, cost_usd, date. Will draft an API contract and a sample CSV.
Owen: I'll prototype the CSV format and a demo SQL to count tokens per route. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Ivy: SummitCare SSO - please escalate. Marcus, can you grab the IdP trace and create a short repro?
Marcus: pasted IdP trace to #eng-runtime (link in CRM row). Created ticket CS-11021 "SSO attr mismatch - summitcare" and flagged blocking_renewal. Assigned to @sre-oncall.
sre-oncall: Acknowledged CS-11021. Will attempt repro and aim for 48h turnaround.
Hannah: For Admin Quickstart, I can author a one-page PDF + JSON schema. Will include an "IdP mapping checklist" so CS can try config fixes before escalation. ETA next Tue.
Ivy: embedding reingest: two customers reported >36h lag. Could we add a "last indexed" timestamp and a manual reingest action? That would reduce support lift.
Owen: will add a small flag to the spike: last_indexed_ts + reingest_action + webhook. If feasible, include a "reindex_now" button in Console.
Ivy: Suggest adding intake columns in the sheet: blocking_renewal (yes/no), customers_affected, first_reported_date, suggested_owner. That should speed triage.
Marcus: linking CS-11021 + draft CSV in the product-intake sheet. Posting top-3 to Monday PM sync.
csbot: Ticket CS-11021 created and linked to thread.
Ivy: Thanks team. I'll consolidate rows, attach call notes, and ping PMs for prioritization. :sparkles:
